scope: Read-only clinical review of the neutral number-line candidate after user confusion about the filled risk/overlap zone. This approval does not replace rendered UX or novice-comprehension verification.

source_design_check.neutral_baseline_and_ticks: Approved: one sample pin plus separate review and laboratory cutoffs. The prior filled risk band and overlap window are removed.
source_design_check.risk_modifier_not_optimum: Approved: the review cutoff is labelled When to review/Cuándo revisarlo. Accessible text explicitly distinguishes it from a normal range or optimal target.
source_design_check.lab_meaning: Approved: the lab cutoff is separately identified as this example reference limit; the sample is within that reference.
source_design_check.context: Visible persistence, repeat-when-well, lab-variation and no-diagnosis copy remain. Fuller overall-risk/history/acute-inflammatory-cause context is available in native details.
source_design_check.no_extra_paragraph: No additional visible clinical paragraph is required for this scoped educational example.

wording_checked.en: Above 2 mg/L? Repeat when well. If still raised, review overall heart risk.
wording_checked.es: ¿Más de 2 mg/L? Repite cuando estés bien. Si sigue elevado, valora el riesgo cardiovascular global.
